title: Accenture Technology Vision 2020: We, the Post-Digital People: Can your enterprise survive the tech-clash?
notes: Five trends. Each has a name, a printed subtitle (in the Introduction overview) and a two-sentence summary; the quote is the first summary sentence. Published date from PDF creation date (2020-02-14). The foreword says 'This year marks the 20th anniversary of our Tech Vision'. No fixed edition-level horizon. pdftotext dropped spaces in some words; spaces restored in quotes.

entries.label: The I in Experience
entries.quote: Redesign digital experiences with new models that amplify personal agency.
entries.subject: Personalized, participatory digital experiences
entries.note: Printed subtitle: 'Helping people choose their own adventure'.

entries.label: AI and Me
entries.quote: Take a new approach that uses artificial intelligence to bring out the full power of people.
entries.subject: Human-AI collaboration
entries.note: Printed subtitle: 'Reimagine the business through human and AI collaboration'.

entries.label: The Dilemma of Smart Things
entries.quote: Address the new reality of product ownership in the era of “forever beta.”
entries.subject: Connected products and software updates
entries.note: Printed subtitle: 'Overcome the “beta burden”'. Present-tense survey: 45 percent of executives believe updates occur with minimal disruption to users.

entries.label: Robots in the Wild
entries.quote: Companies in every industry will unlock new opportunities by introducing robots to the next frontier: the open world.
entries.subject: Robotics outside controlled environments
entries.metric: executives who expect their organizations to use robotics in uncontrolled environments
entries.note: Printed subtitle: 'Growing the enterprise’s reach—and responsibility'. Also in chapter: 95 percent of executives believe their organization will be using robots in uncontrolled environments in five years or more.

entries.label: Innovation DNA
entries.quote: Tap into the unprecedented scale of disruptive technology available today.
entries.subject: Continuous innovation capability
entries.note: Printed subtitle: 'Create an engine for continuous innovation'.
